caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a roughly oval-shaped wooden scoop or ladle with a hollowed-out bowl on one end and a two-pronged handle on the other. The object is shown in a three-quarter view on a plain, off-white background. The wood is depicted as worn and textured, with a pale greenish-gray color and some brownish areas indicating stains or discoloration. The scoop shows a clear separation between the bowl and the handle, with a flat partition at the base of the handle. The handle is elongated, flat, and split into two rounded, parallel extensions connected at the back end. There are visible wood grain patterns, and the dimensions are proportionate, with the scoop forming the broader, deeper section and the handle extending from the side. The illustration is labeled at the bottom with the name "Eugene Bartz," the date "1939," and some additional text including "Series C" and "Frame H.22." There are cross marks in each corner of the image.
title: Wooden Scoop
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
